comment: Routes `check-feature-index.mjs` skips when asserting bidirectional coverage (ADR 0043). Every entry names a dashboard route and carries a written reason; an entry with no reason, naming a route that no longer exists, or naming a route the feature index already covers fails the check. Product features must have feature-index entries; platform-level routes like account management are infrastructure, not features, and are exempted here.

exclusions.reason: Platform-level account management route. Not a product feature — administers user settings, profile, and auth — so it has no row in the feature index.
Phone shell navigation screen (the More tab). It links to existing features and account actions and holds no feature of its own, so it has no row in the feature index.
